METR — Independent Assessment of AI R&D Acceleration at Anthropic in October 2026 (Nov. 2026)

After an eleven-week, high-access evaluation inside Anthropic, METR estimates that Anthropic's benchmark progress has run about 1.9 times its pre-October-2025 rate (95% interval 1.5–2.8x), judges that AI R&D use likely explains most of it, and sees no clear bottlenecks for the next year — while conceding that key evidence was redacted and the public must largely rely on its judgment. Twelve-minute summary, then a three-minute critical Oggy Assessment. Source: https://metr.org/blog/2026-11-05-anthropic-ai-rd-acceleration-assessment/
